primary_estimands.droid: Per checkpoint, report requested-relation-and-release success by direction across up to 30 exact matched pairs, exact paired endpoint ordering, frozen stage, and v3 taxonomy class. If preserved 8300-8302 runtime identities fail, report the registered 27-pair prospective addition without seed substitution.
primary_estimands.robotwin: Per model, report matched LEFT/RIGHT results over seven anchor scenes and ten sampling replicates. The scene/pair is the primary generalization unit; replicate-level results quantify conditional policy-sampling variation.
primary_estimands.no_pooling: Never combine DROID and RoboTwin raw numerators, denominators, failure frequencies, or intervals.

paired_continuous: action RMS over the registered common executed prefix
reporting.failure: Report frozen failure stage and the v3 precedence class jointly; valid failures remain included.
reporting.wam_future: Report only released decodable future evidence, coverage, agreement, and abstentions. Missing or latent-only future evidence is never scored as zero.

hierarchical_16_rollout_analysis.unit: policy-sampling rollout nested within every eligible released Phase-A registered scene/reset/static-instruction condition, then within scene/pair and model
hierarchical_16_rollout_analysis.eligibility: Only runtimes that expose and pass the registered real effective stochastic-seed probe participate. Deterministic or no-effective-seed runtimes are reported ineligible rather than given fake repeats.
hierarchical_16_rollout_analysis.summary: Show all sixteen shared-seed-index rollouts, their conditional success count, and within-condition distribution of continuous fields.
hierarchical_16_rollout_analysis.prohibition: Do not treat sixteen rollouts as sixteen independent scenes or add them as independent scene-level evidence to Phase A.

infrastructure_and_latency: Infrastructure-invalid attempts are ledgered outside behavioral denominators. Thermal/runtime interventions retain behavior but invalidate only the affected operational aggregate according to the ledger.
claim_boundary: This is a disclosed, checkpoint- and arena-specific prospective extension. Separate randomized ablation and wording blocks are exploratory unless a later amendment supplies their own power and inference plan.
